SELECT rolcanlogin AS can_login,
has_schema_privilege('bot_readonly','public','USAGE') AS schema_usage,
has_table_privilege('bot_readonly','public.paper_trades','SELECT') AS paper_select,
has_table_privilege('bot_readonly','public.fills','SELECT') AS fills_select,
has_table_privilege('bot_readonly','public.live_orders','SELECT') AS orders_select,
has_table_privilege('bot_readonly','public.live_paper_twins','SELECT') AS twins_select
FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='bot_readonly'
